findings.title: Command injection via child_process.exec
findings.notes: untrusted req.query.host flows through runCommand() into cp.exec(); cross-function taint. Patched sibling uses execFile with an argument array (no shell).

findings.title: SQL query built by string concatenation
findings.notes: req.params.id flows through loadUser() into a concatenated db.query(); cross-function taint. Patched sibling binds the value as a parameter.

findings.title: SQL query built by string concatenation
findings.notes: untrusted id flows through runQuery() into a concatenated executeQuery(); cross-function taint. Patched sibling uses a PreparedStatement with a bound parameter.

findings.title: SQL query built by string concatenation
findings.notes: untrusted id flows through runQuery() into a concatenated db.Query(); cross-function taint. Patched sibling uses a parameterized query ($1).

findings.title: Command injection via Kernel#system
findings.notes: untrusted input flows through run_cmd() into system(); cross-function taint. Patched sibling escapes the argument via Shellwords.escape.

findings.title: Command injection via system()
findings.notes: untrusted $host flows through runCommand() into system(); cross-function taint. Patched sibling escapes the argument via escapeshellarg().

findings.title: SQL query built by string concatenation
findings.notes: untrusted name flows through Run() into a concatenated SqlCommand; cross-function taint. Patched sibling uses a parameterized SqlCommand (AddWithValue).

findings.title: Command injection via Command::new
findings.notes: untrusted program name flows through run_cmd() into Command::new(); cross-function taint. Patched sibling uses a constant program and passes input only as an argument.

findings.title: Command injection via system()
findings.notes: untrusted string flows through run_cmd() into system(); cross-function taint. Patched sibling uses execlp with a constant program (no shell).

false_positive_traps.reason: Parameterized query (bound ? placeholders) — remediation of GP-SAST-001; expect no SQLi finding.
subprocess with argument list and shlex.quote, no shell — remediation of GP-SAST-002; expect no command-injection finding.
realpath + containment check inside BASE_DIR — remediation of GP-SAST-003; expect no path-traversal finding.
AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE is AWS's published documentation example key, not a real credential.
SHA-256 hex digest of the word 'password' — a one-way digest, not a secret.
Random UUID v4 — an identifier, not a credential.
${DB_PASSWORD} is an environment-variable placeholder resolved at runtime, holds no secret.
jwt.io public demo token signed with the well-known 'your-256-bit-secret' example key.
execFile with a constant binary and an argument array (no shell) - remediation of GP-SAST-014; expect no command-injection finding.
parameterized query (constant SQL + bound value) - remediation of GP-SAST-015; expect no SQLi finding.
PreparedStatement with a bound parameter - remediation of GP-SAST-016; expect no SQLi finding.
parameterized query ($1 placeholder) - remediation of GP-SAST-017; expect no SQLi finding.
argument escaped via Shellwords.escape - remediation of GP-SAST-018; expect no command-injection finding.
argument escaped via escapeshellarg - remediation of GP-SAST-019; expect no command-injection finding.
parameterized SqlCommand (AddWithValue) - remediation of GP-SAST-020; expect no SQLi finding.
constant program with input passed only as an argument - remediation of GP-SAST-021; expect no command-injection finding.
execlp with a constant program (no shell) - remediation of GP-SAST-022; expect no command-injection finding.
